app_description: A web-based configurator for ReBotLab keyboards
landing_description: A web-based configurator for ReBotLab keyboards. Customize keyboard bindings, adjust actuation points, enable Rapid Trigger, and more.
toast_firmware_update_available: Newer version of the firmware is available.
layout_window_too_small: Your window is too small. Please resize your window, or zoom out.
profiles_tab_description: Manage your keyboard profiles here. You can import, export, and customize them.
profiles_tab_import_invalid_json: The selected file is not a valid JSON.
profiles_tab_import_invalid_metadata: The selected file is not a valid keyboard metadata. See console for details.
profiles_tab_schema_error: Unexpected keyboard configuration schema error. See console for details.
ap_description_rt: Set the specific distance at which Rapid Trigger activates and deactivates.
ap_description_normal: Set the specific distance at which a key press and release is registered.
rt_description: Rapid Trigger registers key presses and releases based on changes in key distance rather than absolute position. It activates and deactivates at the actuation point.
rt_press_sensitivity_description: Set the minimum distance change required for Rapid Trigger to register a key press.
rt_sensitivity_description: Set the minimum distance change required for Rapid Trigger to register a key press or release.
rt_release_sensitivity_description: Set the minimum distance change required for Rapid Trigger to register a key release.
rt_separate_sensitivity_description: Configure sensitivity for key presses and releases independently.
rt_continuous_description: Deactivates Rapid Trigger only when the key is fully released, instead of at the actuation point.
ak_socd_description: Select 2 keys and configure how simultaneous opposing inputs are resolved.
ak_dks_description: Assign up to 4 bindings to a single key. Each binding can be configured with 4 different actions based on the key's position.
ak_tap_hold_description: Register different bindings depending on whether the key is tapped or held.
ak_toggle_description: Toggle between key press and release states. Hold the key for a normal key behavior.
ak_unknown_description: This Advanced Key type is not recognized.
socd_last_input_wins_description: Activate the key that was pressed last. The most common SOCD mode for competitive gaming.
socd_neutral_description: Neither key will be activated when both are pressed simultaneously.
socd_key1_priority_description: Key 1 will always take priority over Key 2.
socd_key2_priority_description: Key 2 will always take priority over Key 1.
socd_distance_priority_description: Activate whichever key is pressed down further. Also known as Rappy Snappy.
socd_configure_description: Select how SOCD resolves key presses when both keys are pressed simultaneously.
socd_alt_fully_pressed_description: Enable this option to register both key presses when keys are fully pressed simultaneously, bypassing the resolution behavior.
socd_perf_enable_rt_description: Enable Rapid Trigger to compare keys only when Rapid Trigger registers a key press. Additional Rapid Trigger options are available in the Performance tab.
socd_perf_ap_description: Set the actuation point at which SOCD becomes active.
socd_perf_bop_description: Set the actuation point at which the key is considered fully pressed.
tap_hold_on_other_key_press_description: Immediately perform the hold action if another non-Tap-Hold key is pressed.
tap_hold_tapping_term_description: Set the duration the key must be held to perform the hold action.
toggle_tapping_term_description: Set the duration the key must be held to perform the normal key behavior.
dks_configure_description: Assign bindings using the menu on the left. For a tap action, click the plus icon once. For a hold action, click the plus icon and drag it to the desired key position based on your preferred behavior.
dks_perf_ap_description: Set the actuation point for "Key press" and "Key release" actions.
dks_perf_bop_description: Set the actuation point for "Key fully pressed" and "Key released from fully pressed" actions.
dks_perf_rt_disabled: Rapid Trigger is automatically disabled for Dynamic Keystroke keys.
socd_mode_last_input_description: Activate the key that was pressed last.
socd_mode_abs_key1_description: Key 1 will take priority over Key 2.
socd_mode_abs_key2_description: Key 2 will take priority over Key 1.
socd_mode_distance_description: Activate whichever key is pressed down further.
gamepad_configure_description: Assign gamepad buttons to your keyboard.
gamepad_enable_keyboard_description: Allow keyboard inputs to be sent along with gamepad inputs.
gamepad_override_description: Disable keyboard inputs on keys bound to gamepad buttons.
gamepad_enable_xinput_description: Allow your keyboard to be recognized as an Xbox controller for gamepad input. Restart the keyboard to apply changes. This setting applies globally across all profiles.
gamepad_analog_description: Modify how keyboard analog values translate to gamepad analog inputs. You can manually adjust the analog curve or select a preset from below. These settings affect both joysticks and triggers.
gamepad_square_joystick_description: Remove the circular boundaries of the joystick for full range of motion.
gamepad_snappy_joystick_description: Use the maximum analog value between opposite joystick axes instead of combining them for more responsive movement.
switch_profile_description: Select the switch type installed on the selected keys. This improves calibration accuracy for mixed-switch builds.
calibration_save_bottom_out_description: Periodically save the per-key bottom-out threshold values after some inactivity to be restored on next boot. The saved values will only be cleared on recalibration. This setting applies globally across all profiles.
calibration_initial_noise_floor_descript: The initial noise floor represents the estimated analog value when a key is at rest. It should be set slightly higher than the actual analog readings of all keys in their resting position to prevent deadzones. Recalibrate the keyboard to apply changes. This setting applies globally across all profiles.
calibration_initial_bottom_out_descripti: The initial bottom out threshold represents the estimated change in analog value when a key is fully pressed. It should be set slightly lower than the actual change in analog readings when keys are fully pressed to prevent deadzones. Recalibrate the keyboard to apply changes. This setting applies globally across all profiles.
calibration_warning_description: This tab requests data from the keyboard at a high frequency, which may impact performance. Please close this tab or switch to another one when performing other performance-sensitive tasks with your keyboard.
settings_polling_rate_description: Enable the 8000Hz polling rate for faster response times, but may increase the CPU usage of the host device. Restart the keyboard to apply changes. This setting applies globally across all profiles.
settings_firmware_update_description: Update the keyboard firmware via USB DFU. The keyboard will restart into bootloader mode during the update process.
settings_restart_description: The keyboard will disconnect and reconnect. No changes will be made to your keyboard settings.
settings_bootloader_description: The keyboard will restart and enter bootloader mode if it is supported by the firmware. No changes will be made to your keyboard settings.
settings_factory_reset_description: Revert the keyboard to its factory settings defined by the firmware. All user data and settings will be lost.
settings_factory_reset_confirm_descripti: Are you sure you want to factory reset your keyboard?
firmware_update_intro: This will update your keyboard's firmware. The keyboard will restart into bootloader mode, then the new firmware will be written via USB.
firmware_update_warning: Do not disconnect the keyboard during the update. If something goes wrong, hold the DFU button on the keyboard while plugging it in to enter recovery mode.
firmware_connect_prompt: The keyboard has been restarted in bootloader mode. Click the button below to connect to the DFU device.
firmware_windows_note: Windows users: If the DFU device does not appear, you may need to install the WinUSB driver using Zadig. Select the DFU device and install the WinUSB driver.
firmware_dfu_connected: DFU device connected. Select a firmware file (.bin) to flash.
firmware_writing: Writing firmware to device... Do not disconnect the keyboard.
firmware_success: Firmware has been updated successfully. The keyboard will restart automatically.
firmware_recovery_note: If the keyboard is unresponsive, hold the DFU button while plugging it in to enter recovery mode, then try again.
ak_remove_description: Are you sure you want to remove this binding?
tap_hold_configure_description: Assign bindings for tap and hold actions of the key.
toggle_configure_description: Assign a binding for the toggle action of the key.
ak_tick_rate_description: The tick rate determines the delay between two consecutive actions performed by Advanced Keys. For example, a tap action performs a key press and release consecutively. A lower tick rate means less delay, but may result in missed inputs if the game or application cannot keep up with processing the inputs.
ak_tick_rate_info: The tick rate is per profile and only affects Dynamic Keystroke and Tap-Hold keys.
switch_type_auto_description: Use the global calibration threshold. Select this if your switch is not listed.
